exposure: antenatal anemia with hemoglobin less than 10 g/dL
cohort: Women who gave birth between 2011 and 2019
finding: Retained placenta and antenatal anemia (hemoglobin < 10 g/dL) were found to be independent risk factors for major transfusion.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be an independent risk factor for major transfusion postpartum.
